intro: Kreldig Ungor has the last of the items Leftwitch wants, and he admits it is not pretty and will take longer than the others. All of it comes from demons: brains, wings and vials of blood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is the last of the items, and I won't lie, it ain't pretty. I'm also expecting this to take you a little bit longer than the other items.

So, enough with the warning, let's get this started. Leftwitch says he needs: ten brains from either mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. Ten nether wings from a nether maiden, sister or sorceress. And... Ten vials of doomwarder blood from a doomwarder captain, or lord.
Simple enough, huh? Sheesh... If you wanna pass on this one, I'd understand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I didn't even realize these demon things were in Desolace. Last I read, centaur pretty much owned the land after the night elves picked up and left years ago.
I wonder why they took up here, and how.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Honestly? I wouldn't have thought it. You're amazing, friend. Taking on demons for a mage's experiments, and coming back in one piece to boot. Great job!
I'm personally gonna tell Roetten about you when I get back to Ironforge.
